# dsh-hf-spaces

> A DeepSeek Harness plugin, pre-alpha and in its design phase, that lets the Harness use an LLM
> served from a GPU Hugging Face Space. The Space starts on demand and stops when idle, and live
> progress, cost and balance are shown in the Harness interface. Credentials are referenced by
> name, never stored in configuration. There is no working plugin code yet.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): mandatory rules for AI agents and contributors (no secrets, no personal data, English only, offline tests, no breakage on Harness updates)
- [README.md](README.md): what the plugin does, credentials, configuration, compatibility, roadmap
- [docs/design.md](docs/design.md): architecture, Space lifecycle, configuration schema, progress protocol, Hugging Face and Harness facts with dates
- [docs/contracts.md](docs/contracts.md): verified Hugging Face and Harness API contracts (responses, verification level, date); read before writing code that calls them

## Reference

- [examples/config.example.yml](examples/config.example.yml): commented configuration with fake values
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): changes by version
